notes: Gold temple spectacles ca.1785 (MHS; Fleishman dating via McCaffrey). Soft onset year; no day-dated purchase. Living reading/writing use narrative.
Commonplace-book p.251: hit head above eye Jan 1788 departing for church; mentions Horace. Post-onset near-work diary pin (MHS Ms.SBd-219).
Anonymous 60p pamphlet on Jacob/Esau (Isaiah Thomas 1791) — sole broad public piece of bespectacled period (McCaffrey; AAS Haven).
John Johnston oil 1791: library/reader identity; spectacles absent from portrait (McCaffrey fig.1).
Weston 14 Jun 1792: 'no end of burning old wills, and executing new ones' (Commonplace p.270–71). Day-dated FROM-him near-work.
Penned mother's obituary (McCaffrey); printed Columbian Centinel 21 Jun 1797; Dexter Genealogy 42–43.
Jan 1802: complains of ophthalmia; fears total blindness (Commonplace p.308). Still writing under spectacles.
Mar 1809 eighty-third birthday: yearly 'holy gratitude… mitigation of my bodily pains & infirmities' (Commonplace p.332). Last hard pin.
Death ~10 Jun 1810 (WD); funeral sermon Kendal at Mendon 14 Jun 1810. years_after=25 from 1785 onset; hard series to 1809-03.
